title: Marketing Analyst/Senior Analyst
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a Marketing Analyst/Senior Analyst for Free Fire who will be responsible to lead high-impact marketing campaigns and special projects with autonomy and ownership. This role combines strategic thinking with creativity in a fast-paced, project-based environment where no two days are the same. Ideal for candidates who thrive amid ambiguity, take initiative, and are eager to grow quickly by solving meaningful challenges.


If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we’d love to work with you!


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Exclusivity contract required.


Responsibilities:

  • Campaign Planning: Develop end-to-end marketing campaign plans that align with the overall marketing strategy, grounded in clear rationale and player insights, and bring new innovative ideas.
  • Project Management: Lead campaign execution as project manager, ensuring cross-functional coordination with local teams, global stakeholders, and external partners to ensure high-quality, on-time deliverables.
  • Performance Analysis: Evaluate campaign effectiveness and ROI of marketing levers to inform future planning and optimize spend.
  • Player & Product Insight: Develop a deep understanding of the game and its community to bridge global marketing initiatives with authentic, locally relevant insights.
  • Special Projects: Tackle high-priority initiatives to drive innovation and improve team efficiency, often in unstructured or ambiguous problem spaces.


Main job requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Candidates from other disciplines with relevant experience or skills are also encouraged to apply;
  • Experience: Solid experience working with product marketing, brand management, strategic planning, management consulting, or leadership development programs. Demonstrated experience in project-based, strategic environments and case competitions is a strong plus;
  • Passion for Gaming: Must be an active gamer and regular consumer of gaming-related content;
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken;
  • Specific tool skills: Proficient in Excel (e.g., pivot tables, X/VLOOKUP, basic analysis);
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.

title: Arquiteto Especialista de Soluções SAP
description:
Atividades:

  • Desenhar e documentar arquiteturas de solução SAP, considerando princípios de Clean Core, modularidade, escalabilidade, segurança e custo total de propriedade (TCO).
  • Atuar como especialista técnico em SAP S/4HANA, RISE with SAP e Business Technology Platform (BTP) incluindo Integration Suite (CPI, API Management, Cloud Connector), SAP Datasphere, Process Automation e SAP Build assegurando integração plena com soluções corporativas (legados, ServiceNow, DataLake, etc.).
  • Garantir a governança Clean Core, orientando o uso de extensões in-app e side-by-side e promovendo o reuso de APIs, eventos e componentes reutilizáveis.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de negócio e TI na definição de roadmaps tecnológicos e integrações com o ecossistema corporativo, sustentando decisões de arquitetura com critérios técnicos e de valor agregado.
  • Assegurar conformidade com padrões corporativos de arquitetura, governança de dados, segurança da informação.
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio e TI na elaboração de roadmaps tecnológicos, garantindo que soluções SAP estejam alinhadas às estratégias corporativas e aos objetivos de eficiência operacional.
  • Elaborar pareceres técnicos para submissão aos comitês de arquitetura, detalhando alternativas, impactos, riscos e benefícios das soluções propostas.
  • Contribuir com o repositório de arquitetura corporativa, registrando artefatos, padrões, diagramas e componentes reutilizáveis.
  • Apoiar a adoção de tecnologias emergentes no ecossistema SAP, como IA generativa, automação de processos, low-code/no-code, integração com dados em nuvem e analytics.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em arquitetura funcional e técnica nos módulos FI, CO, PM, MM, e SD, integrações e customizações.
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA, BTP, Integration Suite (CPI), Cloud Connector, Datasphere, IAS/IAG, CAP e RAP.
  • Experiência em arquitetura híbrida (SAP + legados), APIs REST/SOAP, eventos (EDA), barramentos (ESB) e mensageria corporativa.
  • Experiência em modelagem com LeanIX, BiZZdesign, Ardoq, Visio ou similares.
  • Conhecimento de estratégias de extensão side-by-side, automação e racionalização de customizações Z.
  • Conhecimento de instalação, tuning, monitoramento e disaster recovery de ambientes SAP HANA e Oracle.
  • Familiaridade com RISE with SAP, GROW with SAP, ambientes GCP e modelos híbridos (on-premise + cloud).
  • Conhecimento de integração SAP Datasphere, DataLake e SAP Analytics Cloud.
  • Experiência em programas de “Back to Standard” e redução de Z-códigos, racionalizando customizações e alinhando o landscape SAP às boas práticas de extensibilidade serão considerados diferenciais.


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Superior completo em Analise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração ou áreas correlatas.


Local de Trabalho:

  • Barra da Tijuca/RJ

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?


“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."


Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer


What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:

  • Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
  • Review code and mentor (junior) engineers;
  • Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
  • Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.


What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
  • benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
  • focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
  • annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
  • tech events and knowledge sessions.


This will make you better:

  • contract for indefinite period of time;
  • an all-in employee benefit package ( €61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance;
  • good secondary employment conditions: i.a. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.


This will keep you healthy:

  • a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
  • an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
  • the home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
  • lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.


What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
  • You are capable of defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
  • A background in software development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
  • Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
  • You have proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
  • You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Repórter Investigativo de Política
description:
Sobre o Bastidor


Somos um veículo criado por Diego Escosteguy com a missão de iluminar os segredos do poder. Nossa matéria-prima são notícias exclusivas e de alto impacto, seja por meio de informações sintéticas, seja por meio de reportagens profundas. Cobrimos assuntos e casos difíceis, que envolvem grandes personagens da vida política e econômica nacional. Praticamos jornalismo independente e apartidário com rigor profissional, mediante investigação crítica de fatos de interesse público.


Valorizamos trabalho em equipe, apuração constante junto a fontes humanas e uso avançado de ferramentas digitais e de IA para obtenção, checagem e análise de fontes documentais.


Sobre a vaga


Procuramos um repórter investigativo para cobrir, majoritariamente, Congresso Nacional. Experiência é desejável, mas não é o mais importante; buscamos talentos que tenham disposição para aprender e vontade de se tornar um grande repórter. Nossa cobertura de Câmara e Senado envolve tanto movimentos de bastidor e articulações políticas quanto acompanhamento crítico e fiscalizador de assuntos relevantes - sempre sob a supervisão de nossos editores.


Responsabilidades


  • Mapear, priorizar e explicar pautas de alto impacto (plenário e comissões).
  • Ler e interpretar pareceres, relatórios, emendas, LOA/LDO, diários e atas.
  • Construir e preservar fontes (lideranças, relatorias, consultorias, assessorias, mercado) com ética.
  • Investigar trilhas documentais (Portal da Transparência, ComprasGov, e‑SIC/LAI, TCU).
  • Trabalhar em parceria com editores e colegas para desenvolver pautas próprias e séries investigativas.
  • Usar ferramentas digitais/IA para triagem, verificação e organização de materiais.


Requisitos (obrigatórios)


  • Graduação em Jornalismo (concluída).
  • Domínio da Língua Portuguesa (clareza, lógica, gramática e edição).
  • Técnicas básicas de apuração (entrevista, checagem, leitura de documentos).
  • Conhecimento básico do Legislativo brasileiro (regimento, tramitação, orçamento).
  • Predisposição para construir e preservar fontes com ética e responsabilidade.
  • Independência e apartidarismo; julgamento editorial equilibrado.
  • Espírito crítico, curiosidade intelectual, trabalho em equipe e abertura a feedback.
  • Conforto com planilhas e pesquisa em bases públicas; disposição para aprender IA.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)


  • Vivência em Brasília/legislativo; leitura avançada de regimento.
  • Noções de dados (limpeza, cruzamento) e/ou Python/SQL.
  • Inglês de leitura.


O que você aprenderá no Bastidor


  • Técnicas avançadas de reportagem e produção de exclusivas de alto impacto.
  • Pesquisa e obtenção de evidências jornalisticamente úteis (bases públicas e privadas).
  • Análise empírica e lógica de evidências e valoração criteriosa de fatos (epistemologia aplicada ao jornalismo).
  • Redação assertiva, equilibrada e clara, sem clichês, ilações ou hipérboles.
  • Uso avançado de IA e ML para organização, pesquisa e análise de casos.
  • Segurança operacional (física e digital) e proteção de fontes e documentos.


Como se candidatar


Pelo LinkedIn ou envie seu currículo para com "Repórter Investigativo de Política" e seu nome no campo de assunto. Inclua links para até três reportagens de sua autoria e um texto de até 300 palavras que descreva por que você quer trabalhar conosco.

title: Analista Pleno de Serviços Cloud
description:
Realizar o atendimento de suporte à infraestrutura dos ambientes dos clientes, contribuindo com a satisfação dos clientes atendidos pela operação Cloud


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

Realizar o atendimento aos ambientes dos clientes Cloud por meio dos canais TOTVS, resolvendo assuntos de média complexidade referente à infraestrutura;

● Revisar e classificar os tickets (se necessário), com a categoria adequada e por meio da execução do processo definido, visando o atendimento às metas estabelecidas;

● Registrar a solicitação do cliente com todas as evidências (tickets abertos) de detalhamento

necessárias para todos os impactados, por meio do sistema de atendimento;

● Escalonar para o próximo nível as solicitações ou incidentes que não forem evoluídos (após o

esgotamento das possibilidades de solução dentro do tempo estimado pela Coordenação da área), por meio do registro de incidente/ou problema na ferramenta de atendimento, detalhando as ações realizadas e os resultados, para que o próximo nível consiga dar sequência a solução;

● Avaliar os tickets abertos pelo cliente e reclassificar ou categorizar (quando necessário), seguindo os processos documentados pela área, para adequação de demanda;

● Fornecer status das demandas em evolução (quando solicitado pelo cliente e/ou equipes internas), por meio de canais de atendimento (telefônico, por e-mail, sistema);

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Enterprise Architect who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Job Description:


The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments.


Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position Vale as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects,
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.

Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.

Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Analista de desenvolvimento de produtos
description:
Analista de Desenvolvimento do Produto - SISTEMAS EMBARCADOS


RESUMO

O profissional escolhido estará inserido no time GLOBAL de RnD da Engenharia do Produto de uma multinacional, trabalhando com foco no projeto e desenvolvimento de sistemas embarcados que permitam funcionalidades avançadas de controle em produtos de linha branca.

Será responsável pelo desempenho diário das atribuições de projetos de desenvolvimento da engenharia do produto, que podem variar em complexidade, desde a aplicação em nível de componente até o desenvolvimento completo do sistema em si.

Aplicará princípios de engenharia para atingir metas e objetivos de forma eficaz, dentro do prazo e das restrições de custo.

Terá interação direta com todos os departamentos, fornecedores e clientes dentro do escopo da posição. E fornecerá atualizações periódicas de status à gerência de engenharia, conforme necessário.

Por fim, irá prover liderança técnica e expertise em desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a produção.


FORMAÇÃO

Formação superior ou cursando Engenharias de Software, Eletrônica, Elétrica, da Computação ou Ciência da Computação.

Mestrado é um diferencial.


AMBIENTE DE TRABALHO

Engenharia do Produto - Time GLOBAL.


RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Projetar software/firmware de forma independente para controles e sistemas de controle eletrônicos com conteúdo técnico significativo;
  • Desenvolver especificações de software com base em uma variedade de requisitos, incluindo design de consumidor, marketing e industrial, e especificação de produto;
  • Liderar e participar de todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software embarcado, como projeto de software, codificação, depuração, verificação, validação etc.;
  • Realizar revisão de projeto de software e revisão de código;
  • Executar análise estática de código, testes de caixa branca, testes de caixa cinza e participar da preparação e execução de planos de validação de firmware;
  • Desenvolver software de interface de usuário para PC, permitindo que engenheiros configurem, depurem e façam os diagnósticos das placas embarcadas;
  • Desenvolver documentação detalhada de engenharia, incluindo documentos de projeto de software, especificações, manuais e outras documentações do cliente, procedimentos de desenvolvimento e teste, avisos de Mudanças de Engenharia e procedimentos de fabricação;
  • Oferecer suporte aos engenheiros em tópicos relacionados a software/firmware para certificação técnica americana UL (Underwriters Laboratories) UL60730 e UL858;
  • Participar da revisão do projeto de hardware e trabalha com engenheiros de hardware para fornecer soluções alternativas;
  • Fornecer suporte e treinamento sobre novos produtos para outros departamentos e clientes, conforme necessário;
  • Estimar a duração das tarefas e auxiliar na preparação do projeto;
  • Demonstrar comportamento profissional adequado, incluindo atitude positiva, senso de urgência, julgamento independente, trabalho em equipe, pensamento criativo e integridade pessoal para atingir as metas e objetivos do departamento/corporação;
  • Trabalhar com consultores externos, fornecedores e fabricantes contratados para desenvolver e fabricar componentes e conjuntos eletrônicos;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com Compras e Qualidade para investigar, qualificar, selecionar e gerenciar fornecedores de eletrônicos;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a manufatura para garantir a transição tranquila de novos projetos para o processo de produção, incluindo suporte desde a fase piloto até o ramp-up completo da produção;
  • Apoiar integralmente os programas, políticas e objetivos da empresa onde trabalha, bem como da empresa onde presta serviço.


REQUISITOS

  • Conhecimento avançado em programação C em sistemas embarcados baseados em microcontroladores.
  • Experiência relevante comprovada no desenvolvimento de firmware embarcado, preferencialmente em ambiente de P&D de produtos para linha branca;
  • Experiência no design/programação de firmware C/C++ para sistemas embarcados;
  • Capacidade para gerar especificações de software a partir das especificações do produto;
  • Proficiência em um dos controladores Renesas, Freescale ou ST e familiarizado com o ambiente/ferramentas de desenvolvimento;
  • Experiência com IAR é um diferencial;
  • Capacidade de testar/depurar firmware com osciloscópio, depuradores, emuladores e analisadores lógicos;
  • Histórico comprovado em suporte a todos os aspectos de uma organização de fabricação de eletrônicos para atingir as taxas de produção exigidas.
  • Histórico comprovado na gestão de fornecedores externos para atingir os níveis exigidos de qualidade, desempenho e entrega de componentes, conjuntos e subconjuntos fornecidos;
  • Experiência com requisitos de agências e normas, preferencialmente (IEC/UL60730, normas, especialmente aquelas relacionadas a produtos de linha branca);
  • Sólido conhecimento em processos de fabricação de eletrônicos;
  • Conhecimento e experiência em integração de sistemas e nas interações entre design de hardware e software.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Disposição para seguir as orientações da equipe em arquitetura de software e outros processos de desenvolvimento. Capacidade de aprimorar processos é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento e experiência em desenvolvimento de software modular;
  • Conhecimento e experiência com testes de caixa branca, análise estática de código e software classe B de segurança IEC/UL60730;
  • Experiência com controle de versão, rastreamento de problemas e ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos (Git, Jira, PTC);
  • Experiência com tecnologia de toque capacitivo;
  • Capacidade de interpretar esquemas. Conhecimento em projeto de hardware.


IDIOMAS

Inglês avançado mandatório .


PERFIL

  • Capaz de trabalhar como membro integral e colaborador de equipes nacionais e internacionais de desenvolvimento técnico de eletrônicos;
  • Capaz de trabalhar com eficácia dentro de restrições de tempo, prioridades variáveis e de forma independente;
  • Capaz de organizar e gerenciar a carga de trabalho para dar suporte eficaz a múltiplos projetos.
  • Com excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto escritas quanto orais.


HORÁRIO DE TRABALHO

Segunda à sexta das 08:00 às 17:30;


REMUNERAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS

  • Contrato CLT por tempo indeterminado;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação e Consultoria Sênior
description:
Analista de Segurança da Informação e Consultoria Sênior


A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior para atuar em parceria com um cliente do segmento de seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

- Avaliação de Ameaças e Riscos: Identificar e avaliar as ameaças e riscos de segurança durante a implementação dos projetos de negócio, garantindo que todos os aspectos críticos sejam analisados e mitigados.

- Definição de Requisitos de Segurança : Definir os requisitos necessários para garantir um nível adequado de segurança da informação em todos os componentes dos projetos, assegurando a conformidade com as políticas de segurança da empresa.

- Acompanhamento de Projetos : Monitorar o desenvolvimento dos projetos, garantindo que os requisitos de segurança sejam seguidos e que o progresso atenda às expectativas e metas estabelecidas.

- Verificação de Aderência : Avaliar a aderência dos projetos aos requisitos de segurança da informação e aos componentes necessários para mitigar riscos e garantir a proteção dos dados e sistemas.

- Relatórios de Não-Conformidades e Débitos Técnicos: Identificar, reportar e acompanhar as não-conformidades e débitos técnicos dos projetos relacionados à segurança cibernética, garantindo que as ações corretivas sejam implementadas.

- Avaliação de Riscos de Fornecedores e Soluções : Realizar a avaliação de riscos associados a fornecedores e analisar soluções de segurança para garantir que atendam aos padrões exigidos pela organização.

- Análises e Melhorias de Processos de Segurança : Conduzir análises contínuas e implementar melhorias nos processos de segurança, buscando sempre otimizar a proteção e reduzir vulnerabilidades.

- Garantia de Proteção nos Produtos e Processos : Ter uma visão holística dos produtos e processos da vertical, assegurando que estejam adequadamente protegidos com as ferramentas e práticas de segurança da informação.

- Assessoria em Processos de Negócio : Oferecer assessoria nas áreas de negócios, identificando oportunidades de melhoria, mitigação de riscos, correção de falhas na execução de processos e cobertura de riscos não abordados em relação à Tecnologia da Informação.

- Orientação sobre a Esteira de Segurança : Orientar as equipes sobre a utilização correta da esteira de segurança, promovendo boas práticas e garantindo a conformidade com os protocolos estabelecidos.

Requisitos e qualificações

- Ensino Superior Completo;

- Conhecimento dos principais frameworks de segurança e proteção de dados (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, PCI DSS);

- Conhecimento em Modelagem de ameaças e riscos.

- Conhecimento de proteção de dados, criptografia, soluções de segurança da informação. (Ex: IPS, UTM, WAF, Proxy, Antivírus, VPN, SIEM, Proteção DDoS, DLP, NAC, Prisma Cloud);

- Experiência em projetos de segurança da informação;

- Experiência em avaliação de riscos cibernéticos em projetos;

- Elaboração de Apresentação de indicadores e relatórios de vulnerabilidades;

- Experiência em melhoria contínua relacionado a Segurança da Informação;

- Conhecimento em infraestrutura de TI (Datacenter, Infraestrutura, Telecom, Firewall, Clouds: AWS, GCP ou Azure, Cisco Umbrella);

- Conhecimento em SOC, CSIRT e Hunting.

title: Senior Data Administrator
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Data Administrator who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid (with the possibility of 100% remote) , in the city of Londrina.


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES *

Main Responsibilities

● Data Modeling: Design, develop, and maintain relational and multidimensional data models to meet the requirements of transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP/Data Warehouse) systems.


● Metadata Management: Manage the data catalog, defining business concepts, maintaining data lineage, and ensuring that metadata is clear and accessible.


● Data Quality: Implement and monitor data quality rules, identify anomalies, and collaborate with business and development teams to correct inconsistencies.

● Data Governance: Support the creation, curation, and evolution of best practice guides and standards for data modeling and integration, ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulations such as the LGPD (Brazilian General Data Protection Law).

● Implementation and Curation: Create and curate physical data models in databases, ensuring that the implementation is aligned with the logical design.

● Technical Collaboration: Act as a point of reference for development, BI, and data science teams, offering support and expertise on issues related to data structure and access.


Nice to Have:

● Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) applied to data projects (DataOps).

● Knowledge of other data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation). ● Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), especially with database and data lake services.

● Advanced or fluent English for collaboration with global teams.

● Previous experience in the company's sector (e.g., finance, retail, industry).


JOB REQUIREMENTS


MINIMUM REQUIREMENT FOR THE POSITION * DESIRABLE

Education Experience

Minimum Education and Experience

● Education: Completed and proven higher education in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related fields. Short courses or predominantly online courses will not be considered as primary education.

● Experience: Minimum of 6 years of market experience, working directly with data modeling, administration, and governance.

● Professional Stability: Average of 2 years of tenure in previous jobs, according to resume history. Certifications (Desirable)

● At least one active certification, such as:

○ DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) - Associate or Practitioner level.

○ Certification in specific tools (e.g., Informatica, Oracle).


Technical Skills

Technical Skills (Hard Skills)

● Proficiency in relational (3NF) and dimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake) data modeling.

● Proven experience with data modeling tools, preferably Oracle SQL Developer Data Modeler.

● Solid knowledge of Data Governance tools for Catalog, Lineage, and Quality, preferably the Informatica suite (IDMC/Axon/EDC).

● In-depth knowledge of the General Data Protection Law (LGPD) and its application in data architectures.

● Proficiency in SQL for data analysis, manipulation, and validation.


● Knowledge of Data Warehousing, Data Marts, and Business Intelligence concepts. Behavioral Competencies (Soft Skills)

● Analytical Vision: Ability to analyze complex requirements and translate them into effective data solutions.

● Assertive Communication: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences (technical and business).

● Organization and Focus: Discipline to manage multiple projects and priorities autonomously.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (SOC)
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Buscamos um Analista de SOC para atuação nas operações de segurança. Você será responsável por garantir a triagem de falsos positivos, análise e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança e manter a operação do SOC alinhada às melhores práticas do mercado.

Habilidades e Requisitos

Realizar triagem de falsos positivos, análise, contenção e resposta a incidentes de segurança cibernética;

Conhecimento sobre ameaças cibernéticas, incluindo engenharia reversa, buffer overflow, shellcode, ofuscação, hijacking e process injection;

Habilidade em linguagens de programação para automação de processos;

Familiaridade com criptografia e suas aplicações;

Estabelecer procedimentos, métricas e indicadores de desempenho para o SOC;

Apoiar investigações forenses e análise de logs em caso de incidentes críticos;

Desenvolver e revisar playbooks e plano de resposta a incidente;

Elaborar relatórios e reportes executivos;

Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de TI e times de infraestrutura;

Conhecimento em normas e frameworks como ISO 27000, ITIL, FIPS 140-2, CWE, CVSS, CVE e MITRE ATT&CK, além de experiência em EDR e MDR;

Experiência intermediária em plataformas e arquiteturas On-Premises e nuvem; (Como ainda temos pouca coisa em nuvem, achei melhor colocar os dois modelos;

Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e ferramentas de segurança.

Hard Skill

Conhecimento em soluções de SIEM, SOAR, antivírus, EDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls, Web Gateways, e-mail, proxy, VPN, gateways, WAF, antimalware, proxy, HIDS e NIDS;

Experiência com servidores Linux e Windows, incluindo Active Directory, IIS, DNS, SSL/TLS, WSUS/ Intune/ Autopatch / Azure Update Manager e hardening;

Entendimento aprofundado de protocolos de rede e experiência com ferramentas de análise de pacotes;

Experiência com soluções de segurança em ambientes híbridos (Cloud & On-Premises);

Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações web, incluindo vulnerabilidades e melhores práticas.

Soft Skill

Formação superior em Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, ou áreas correlatas;

Boa capacidade analítica, comunicação clara e habilidades de relacionamento;

Experiência com metodologia ágil;

Boa capacidade de leitura, interpretação e tradução de textos em inglês;

Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal.

Formato de trabalho:Hibrido 3 x em Alphaville e 2x Home Office na semana

E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

The goal is to provide modern, secure, efficient environments aligned with user needs, ensuring high availability, ease of use, and integration with corporate platforms.

  • Establish standards and frameworks for device provisioning, management, and security, including access policies, identity control (IAM), encryption, and threat protection.
  • Lead modernization and digital transformation initiatives for smart workspaces, with a focus on automation, self-service, cloud integration, collaboration (MS Teams, Zoom), and mobile applications.
  • Evaluate and implement virtualization, mobile device management (MDM), endpoint security (EDR), zero-trust, monitoring, and remote support technologies.
  • Proactively work to solve performance, scalability, and availability challenges, ensuring support for remote and hybrid work.
  • Collaborate with IT, security, business, and operations to align demands and promote the best end-user experience.
  • Promote effective governance, complying with global regulations (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA) and internal policies.
  • Produce complete documentation, guides, contingency plans, training, and best practices for support and operation teams.
  • Participate in forums, workshops, and innovation projects to keep the technological environment in line with global trends.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Higher education in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or similar areas.
  • Solid experience (minimum 8 years) in architecture, management and innovation of the End User Computing environment in global companies or highly complex sectors.
  • Advanced knowledge in EUC platforms and tools: Microsoft 365, Windows Desktop, macOS, VDI (Citrix, VMware Horizon), MDM (Intune, MobileIron), collaboration tools (Teams, Zoom).
  • Expertise in device security, zero trust, identity and access management (Azure AD, Okta), encryption, endpoint protection, automation, and monitoring.
  • Experience with hybrid and remote work environments, advanced technical support and strategies to maximize productivity and security.
  • Fluent English for global technical communication, advanced Portuguese for Brazil-Canada alignment.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with technical teams, end users and executives.
  • Analytical skills, solution orientation and user-centered innovation.
  • Leadership, influence, and ability to work in multicultural and collaborative environments.
  • Proactivity, organization and focus on delivering continuous value.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certifications in Project Management (PMP, Prince2) or Change Management (PROSCI Certified Change Practitioner).
  • Specific experience in the mining sector, digital transformation, or major global initiatives.
  • Knowledge of digital tools for Change Management and collaborative communication (MS Teams, SharePoint, Yammer, etc.).

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Solid and scalable architecture of the End User Computing environment for Brazil and Canada.
  • Modernization and automation of workspaces, with substantial improvement of the end-user experience.
  • Ensuring security, compliance, and availability in distributed and hybrid environments.
  • Leadership in the dissemination of best practices, training and qualification of regional teams.
  • Support for digital transformation and user-focused innovation in environments of high operational complexity.


Additional Comments:

Domain Architect – End User Computing is essential to ensure that operations in Brazil and Canada have a unified, secure and efficient digital experience, supporting the current challenges of mobility, security and productivity in hybrid environments.

  • Realizar análises aprofundadas de logs, tráfego de rede, endpoints e outras fontes de dados para identificar a causa raiz dos incidentes e determinar o escopo do impacto.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de resposta a incidentes, garantindo a coordenação eficaz com equipes internas e externas.
  • Documentar detalhadamente os incidentes, as ações tomadas e as lições aprendidas para aprimorar os processos futuros.
  • Participar ativamente na definição e refinamento do playbook de resposta a incidentes.
  • Atuar como ponto focal para solicitações de análise forense digital, tanto em cenários de incidentes quanto em investigações internas ou requisições legais.
  • Definir e aprimorar os processos e ferramentas para a aquisição, preservação, análise e apresentação de evidências digitais.
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo das investigações forenses, garantindo a integridade e a cadeia de custódia das evidências.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico especializado e consultoria em questões relacionadas à análise forense.
  • Colaborar na criação, revisão e teste de planos de continuidade de negócios e recuperação de desastres, garantindo a resiliência dos sistemas e dados críticos.
  • Identificar pontos de falha potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação para minimizar o impacto de interrupções.
  • Participar da simulação e exercícios de BCDR para validar a eficácia dos planos e identificar áreas de melhoria.
  • Garantir a integração dos aspectos de segurança da informação nos planos de continuidade de negócios.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras equipes de TI e de negócios para garantir a segurança de dados.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências e validação de controles relacionados a gestão de incidentes de segurança.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Curso superior completo em Tecnologia.
  • Experiência na área de Segurança da Informação, com foco em investigação e resposta a incidentes.
  • Conhecimento profundo de metodologias e frameworks de resposta a incidentes (e.g., NIST, SANS).
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de SIEM (Security Information and Event Management), EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response), NIDS/NIPS (Network Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em análise forense digital, incluindo aquisição, análise de memória, disco e rede.
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell) para automação de tarefas de segurança e análise.
  • Entendimento de arquiteturas de rede, sistemas operacionais (Windows, Linux) e tecnologias de nuvem.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks de segurança (e.g., ISO 27001, LGPD/GDPR, NIST CSF).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e lidar com situações de crise de forma eficaz.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar informações técnicas de forma clara e concisa para diferentes públicos.
  • Inglês avançado.

title: Loyalty and Subscription Strategies Manager
description:
Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Location: 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Please upload an English version of your resume.


About the Position

We are looking for a strategic and creative professional to lead our Gamification & Subscription Strategies efforts. This role focuses on building innovative mechanisms such as missions, streaks, and loyalty programs that drive user engagement, as well as developing subscription-based models that strengthen recurrence and create long-term value. You will design, test, and scale programs that make our platform fun, sticky, and habit-forming, positioning us to compete head-to-head with established loyalty schemes in the market.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement gamification strategies (progress bars, streaks, missions, rewards) that increase frequency and stickiness across user segments.
  • Develop and refine subscription models and loyalty programs that maximize user retention and LTV, while differentiating from competitor offerings.
  • Collaborate with CRM, Growth, and Product teams to integrate gamification mechanics into the user journey and app experience.
  • Conduct A/B testing and experimentation to evaluate the impact of gamified features and subscription perks on user behavior.
  • Monitor and analyze engagement metrics, progression funnel, and churn patterns to optimize program design and efficiency.
  • Partner with Data and Finance teams to build business cases for gamification and subscription initiatives, measuring ROI and long-term sustainability.
  • Explore partnerships with restaurants, brands, and third parties to enrich the subscription and gamification ecosystem.
  • Stay ahead of market trends and competitor strategies, ensuring our programs are locally relevant, innovative, and scalable.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in business, economics, engineering, or related fields.
  • Robust experience in user operations, loyalty, CRM, or product growth strategy in digital platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in SQL, Python, or other tools to extract insights and validate impact.
  • Demonstrated experience in designing and scaling gamification or subscription programs.
  • Familiarity with user segmentation, behavioral psychology, and habit-forming product design.
  • Background in e-commerce, O2O, food delivery, or subscription-based businesses preferred.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Creative, data-driven, and results-oriented, with the ability to balance user delight with business impact.


We hope to see you soon ;)


#Keeta #EatBetter #Live Better

Role Summary The Marketing Manager 360° sits at the intersection of all cross-functional teams driving the brand and product marketing strategy forward in Brazil. This person blends strategic thinking and creative execution, ensuring the brand remains innovative, disruptive, and locally relevant. You'll bring global campaigns to life in a uniquely Brazilian way, with a consumer-first mindset, a sharp eye for detail, and a passion for brand storytelling and results.


Key Responsibilities


Integrated / 360° Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute the full 360° marketing strategy for Brazil, aligned with LATAM and global direction.
  • Bring to life the brand DNA through impactful and locally relevant campaigns, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (creative, digital, retail, PR, influencer, trade, and education) to deliver cohesive brand experiences.
  • Adapt global campaigns and craft localized initiatives based on strategic insights and consumer behavior.
  • Define KPIs and monitor performance to ensure ROI and continuous optimization.
  • Manage marketing budget efficiently and align investments with business priorities.


Brand Activations, Events & Partnerships

  • Ideate and lead brand activations, pop-ups, and in-store experiences that amplify engagement and conversion.
  • Collaborate with influencer and PR teams to develop creative and culturally relevant events, trips, and product send-outs that generate strong EMV and social buzz.
  • Build and manage brand partnerships that expand audience reach while maintaining aspirational image and consistency. This includes experience with negotiating partnership agreements.
  • Oversee the brand's visual merchandising expression across retail doors, ensuring high-quality, on-brand execution.
  • Partner with the Retail & Education teams to boost service awareness and service sales across stores.
  • Coordinate GWP programs, launch activations, and local communication campaigns with a consumer-centric mindset.
  • The ability to analyze ROI for each activation will be key to ensure the spend had a positive impact on retail sales.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Serve as the local bridge between global brand strategy and field execution.
  • Ensure flawless implementation across channels (in-store, online, influencer, social).
  • Lead project timelines, agency briefings, creative reviews, and post-campaign analysis.
  • Partner with Operations, Supply, and Trade Marketing to secure on-time delivery and smooth rollout.
  • Ensure effective communication and collaboration with sales and finance teams to align objectives and maximize results.
  • Report regularly to management on marketing KPIs, results, and insights.


Who You Are

  • 5–10 years of experience in Marketing or Brand Management within beauty, FMCG, or lifestyle industries.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian retail landscape and consumer behavior.
  • Creative and strategic thinker, with a proven ability to innovate within Global brand guidelines and create data-driven digital campaigns that boost brand awareness and sales.
  • Expertise in marketing strategy combined with strong financial acumen, including proven ability to prepare and manage budgets, analyze marketing spend, forecast sales, and develop data-driven strategies aligned with commercial objectives and measurable impact.
  • Excellent project management and multitasking abilities.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across departments.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and deadline-driven.
  • MANDATORY Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus).
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (especially PowerPoint), Google Workspace, and ideally Asana or Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Passion for beauty, trends, and building emotional consumer connections.
  • Experience working with global brands and adapting marketing strategies to local markets.


Success Metrics

  • Growth in brand awareness and preference above market trend.
  • Increase in service sales and store traffic.
  • Strong ROI on campaigns and activations.
  • Excellent cross-functional alignment and execution quality.
  • Elevated brand perception and consumer engagement.


Why Join Us We're not just selling beauty — we're creating moments of joy, confidence, and connection. If you're a marketer who blends creativity, curiosity, and commercial drive, and you want to make an impact in a dynamic, growing brand — this is your next challenge.

title: SAP Specialist - HCM - SuccessFactors
description:
Job Overview

The SAP/SuccessFactors Specialist will be part of ADM’s Service Delivery Organization , responsible for ensuring high system availability and reliable operations across all ADM systems.

In this role, you will analyze and resolve user tickets, collaborate with internal teams and third-party providers, and ensure timely resolution within defined Operational and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) .

You will also partner with architects, developers, and testers to design and deliver small enhancements aligned with the global template, following approval from the Solution Delivery Organization.


Key Responsibilities


  • Provide deep functional and technical expertise in the respective process area, with solid understanding of key integration points across modules and technical components.
  • Take full ownership of support tickets within your process area; collaborate with integration, development, and external support teams to ensure timely resolution within SLA limits.
  • Maintain integrity of the global and regional templates designed by Solution Delivery teams while resolving incidents.
  • Conduct thorough testing — including regression testing — before final user validation and release.
  • Adhere to ADM IT processes and Service Management standards, ensuring accurate and up-to-date ticket documentation.
  • Design and configure minor system enhancements, following ADM’s configuration and naming standards, and document functional design specifications.
  • Support audit and compliance requests by providing accurate and timely technical inputs.
  • Ensure all activities comply with regulatory, security, and ADM policy requirements .
  • Partner with global process and system experts to identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities in business processes.



Job Requirements


  • Experience in one or more SAP/SuccessFactors modules ; experience with S/4HANA strongly preferred.
  • Functional knowledge in HR processes such as Employee/Personnel Administration, Payroll, Organization Management, Talent, Compensation, Benefits, Time & Attendance, and Learning Management ; experience in HCM or SuccessFactors required.
  • Experience with integration between SAP HCM/SuccessFactors and S/4HANA ; integration with external payroll or learning systems is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of SAP/SuccessFactors localizations supporting global HR deployments.
  • Proven experience in a support analyst role within a medium or large organization.
  • Experience providing 24x7 global support in multicultural, distributed teams.
  • Previous experience leading a team of support analysts is highly preferred.
  • Exposure to full lifecycle SAP implementations and agile methodologies is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with ability to convey complex information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic, and global environment , managing changing priorities with flexibility and professionalism.
  • Strong collaboration, conflict resolution, and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to work occasional weekends, holidays, or different shifts as required to meet SLA commitments.
  • Availability to travel occasionally (domestic and international).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory; Spanish is desirable

title: SAP Functional SD Consultant
description:
ITC Infotech is looking for a SAP SD Consultant to join our team in Brazil.

Work Location: Onsite at Project location.


About Us:

ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.


Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration, implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in local tax and regulatory requirements, including NF-e and Nota Fiscal processes, and experience integrating SAP SD with other core modules. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English, hands-on configuration skills, and the ability to adapt to evolving tax and business environments.

Key responsibilities

  • Configuration and implementation:

Design, configure, and implement SAP SD processes in SAP ECC, adapting the global template to meet Brazilian statutory, tax, and regulatory needs.

  • Localization expertise:

Handle Brazil-specific localization, including e-invoicing (NF-e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and CFOP determination.

  • Tax and compliance:

Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and posting rules.

  • Integration:

Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.

  • Technical collaboration:

Partner with ABAP developers to develop and test functional specifications for custom enhancements (RICEFW).

  • Project and change management:

Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.

  • Support:

Provide cutover and hypercare support after go-live.


Required skills and experience

  • SAP experience: 8-10 years of experience in SAP SD, with a focus on Brazilian localization.
  • Localization knowledge: Deep knowledge of Brazilian SAP localization, including e-transformation and e-document requirements.
  • System knowledge: Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.
  • Functional knowledge: Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is often required.
  • Communication: Strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, and written communication skills.

Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio.


Sobre a SIG


A SIG é líder em sistemas de embalagens e soluções. Trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para levar alimentos aos consumidores de todo o mundo de forma segura, sustentável e acessível. Somos o único fornecedor de um sistema de embalagens que trabalha com embalagens cartonadas e dos tipos pouches e bag-in-box. Nossa tecnologia versátil e nossas habilidades em inovação de produto nos permitem entregar o melhor para nossos clientes, nossos consumidores e para o mundo. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor.

Fundada em 1853, a SIG possui sua sede em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e está listada na Bolsa de Valores SIX Swiss Exchange.

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect


Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.


The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:


As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:


TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR


DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns


DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models


Knowledge and Experience


ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English


DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.


Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: CargoGoogle Ads Specialist - Lead Generation Focus
description:
What We Offer 


Work From Anywhere – 100% remote opportunity with a results-driven global team.

Proven System For Success – No more hitting and hoping. Our battle-tested Google Ads system generates high-quality leads with consistency so you can focus on precision execution and campaign optimization.

Career Development Opportunities – For high performers, there is opportunity to grow into system-building and high-level strategy roles over time.

High-Impact Role – See your work drive results with granular execution and proactive communication.

Elite Team Culture – Join a group of specialists who prioritize precision, data, and high performance.

Paid Time Off As Needed – Take well-deserved breaks whenever you need them.

Who We Are 


Pressure Washing Marketing Pros is a digital marketing agency focused on Google Ads, SEO, and high-converting web design for exterior cleaning companies. By focusing on this niche, we’ve discovered and scaled on repeatable processes that allow us to:


Execute based on data and beat “seat of the pants” traditional strategies.

Deliver predictable, high-quality leads with our proven Google Ads system.

Scale results by constantly testing, refining, and optimizing our paid campaigns.

Our speed, output, and constant improvement help set us apart from our competition.

Your Role & Impact 


As a Google Ads Specialist on our team, you’ll execute and optimize campaigns across 70+ Google Ads accounts and 25+ Local Service Ads accounts. You’ll join our existing Google Ads Manager and Google Ads Specialist who have been with the company for years and who are experts with our system. You and the current Specialist will follow our framework, while proactively collaborating with our SEO and client success teams to ensure campaigns are always in-line with overall business goals.


Key Responsibilities 


Build campaigns in Google Ads Manager and Ads Editor following our templates and SOPs.

Perform weekly and monthly optimization routines (negative keywords, search term reviews, budgets, ad assets, keyword additions, bidding strategy, etc. ). 

Run through QA checklist before launching or editing a campaign (geo settings, match types, naming conventions, conversion actions, etc. ). 

Maintain documentation and task updates in ClickUp. 

Implement and QA tracking with WhatConverts following established processes.

Run reports in Looker Studio with performance analysis.

Manage Local Service Ads (budget pacing, category, verification checks, etc. ). 

Proactively collaborate with SEO and client success managers to align campaign performance with business goals.

Identify areas of improvement to our SOPs based on test results or recurring events.

What You’ll Need to Succeed 


Minimum of 2 years experience managing Google Ads campaigns for lead generation (non-ecommerce).

Track record of precision execution and zero critical errors in recent work.

Great analytical skillset for search term review, budget pacing, and campaign adjustments.

Familiar with Google Ads Manager, Google Ads Editor, GA4, GTM, Looker Studio, ClickUp, and Slack.

Focus on detail, with ability to follow SOPs 100% and identify opportunities for SOP refinement.

Excellent written English for writing ads, documentation, and communicating with cross-functional teams.

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with strong personal standards for flawless execution.

Bonus Experience (not required): 


Experience with Local Service Ads management 

Unbounce 

Experience optimizing paid campaigns for service-based lead generation

Experience with WhatConverts or CallRail 

What We Value  


Data-Driven Execution – Campaigns are backed by analytics, SOPs, and real-time data.

Ownership & Accountability – We don’t micromanage. We hire A-players who take pride in precision and results.

Proactive Communication – Solutions-oriented communication that is clear and timely across departments and time zones.

Fast-Paced Execution – Weekly optimizations and QA routines are non-negotiable.

Continuous Improvement – We are always refining our systems to push performance higher.

Success Metrics 


Zero critical errors found in QA across all campaigns.

100% of weekly optimization routines completed on time.

Campaign pacing within ±5% of budget plan. 

Negative keyword coverage improves irrelevant query share quarter-over-quarter.

Reporting completeness rate 95%+ as measured by manager audit.

Compensation, Benefits, and Schedule 


Base Salary: $1,200–$2,000 USD/month depending on experience and skill level.

Schedule: Flexible work hours but must be available for mandatory 4-hour team overlap for collaboration with cross-department teams.

Multi-Step Hiring Process 


We’re serious about hiring because we’re serious about building a team of disciplined executors who thrive in a high-performance culture.


The hiring process:  


Application and screening questions. 

Paid trial project with strict QA rubric. 

Final interview and debrief with the manager and CEO.

title: Software Engineer
description:
We are actively seeking a highly skilled and experienced Propulsion Integration engineer to join our dynamic team.


Responsibilities:

  • Work with controls development team, motor controls team and foundation software team and receive the inputs for SW integration for electrified PT vehicles.

  • Measure network parameters using CANoe/CANalyzer and prepare measurement using ETAS-INCA.
  • Perform test bench flashing using Lauterbach/Trace32 (embedded debugger testing), INCA, CDA and verification.
  • Support the One-Offs and Prototype Builds for quick development and validation of bug fixes during cold-trip/hot-trip/altitude testing.


Requirements:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or a related Engineering degree from an accredited university Minimum 2 years of engineering experience in software development life cycle for automotive and related industries
  • Minimum 2 years of MATLAB/Simulink experience in code generation using RTW and integration experience with vehicle controllers.
  • Minimum 2 years of ECU software SW development experience with good trouble shooting knowledge of compiler build files and integration.
  • Good cross functional working experience within the organization
  • Excellent communication skills both verbal and written Outstanding problem-solving skills
  • Preferred Qualifications:
  • Masters or advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Software Engineering from an accredited university with 2 or more years of experience with development and testing of powertrain controls in hybrid and/or electric vehicles
  • Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, m-scripting, Visual Basic Experience with AUTOSAR compliant controller development
  • Experience in standard controls tools; modeling, simulation, development, testing, validation, verification Familiarity with OBD II Familiarity with the CMMI and/or ASPICE software development processes


Join our dynamic team and contribute to the development of revolutionary propulsion systems that power our innovative projects. Apply your exceptional skills, knowledge, and enthusiasm to shape the future of transportation and make a significant impact in the industry.

ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration, implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in local tax and regulatory requirements, including NF-e and Nota Fiscal processes, and experience integrating SAP SD with other core modules. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English, hands-on configuration skills, and the ability to adapt to evolving tax and business environments.

Key responsibilities

  • Configuration and implementation:

Design, configure, and implement SAP SD processes in SAP ECC, adapting the global template to meet Brazilian statutory, tax, and regulatory needs.

  • Localization expertise:

Handle Brazil-specific localization, including e-invoicing (NF-e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and CFOP determination.

  • Tax and compliance:

Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and posting rules.

  • Integration:

Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.

  • Technical collaboration:

  • Project and change management:

Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.

  • System knowledge: Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.
  • Functional knowledge: Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is often required.
  • Communication: Strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, and written communication skills.

title: Performance Test Engineer
description:
• Project Description:

The developed product is a leading software system in the Energy domain, covering all aspects of Oil & Gas production—from geological exploration to the optimization of ongoing operations. Our technology solution enables geologists and geophysicists to efficiently research, visualize, and interpret large volumes of geological data.


You'll be joining a senior, supportive, and friendly team, committed to delivering high-quality solutions in the industry.

• Collaborate with software architects, developers, and DevOps to optimize throughput, latency, and resource utilization.

• Monitor key performance indicators (CPU, memory, I/O, network) during test executions using tools like New Relic and correlate results with backend logs and telemetry data.

• Create performance benchmark baselines and contribute to SLAs definition for system responsiveness and throughput.

• Support CI/CD pipelines by integrating performance testing into automated workflows (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps).

• Participate in code and architecture reviews to assess and improve system scalability and resiliency.

• Generate detailed test reports and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.


  • Mandatory Skills Description:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

• 3+ years of experience in performance engineering or testing in enterprise or industrial software.

• Strong Java and/or C# Core understanding with the ability to debug issues, analyse stacktraces, and perform root cause analysis

• Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for test automation.

• Experience with monitoring tools like New Relic, Dynatrace.

• Solid understanding of network latency, threading/concurrency, memory profiling, and database performance (SQL/NoSQL).

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to interpret performance metrics into actionable insights

• Software development background, ability to modify code


  • Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or private data centers supporting oilfield operations.

• Familiarity with oil and gas drilling workflows, real-time data protocols.

• ISTQB or other performance testing certifications.

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Gerente de Field Marketing Sr

A ADP é uma empresa global e uma das líderes de mercado em soluções de RH. Recentemente, ganhou o prêmio de uma das Melhores Empresas para se Trabalhar da Great Place to Work.
